verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like Kick, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. The security docs cover only TLS and AES-256 encryption and Plaid credential handling, which is an adjacent control rather than an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
